name: 01-pair-hero
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE square premium commercial football shoe photograph, no collage, no text overlays. The input photos are factual references for ONE actual XSTARS turf shoe colorway, white textured synthetic upper, white flat laces, red padded collar and red rubber turf outsole, green insole. Repose the actual product professionally according to the shot direction, on a seamless light cool-gray studio floor with subtle natural contact shadow, soft large key light and restrained side light revealing real texture. Crisp commercial photography, realistic affordable synthetic material, no plastic CGI gloss. Preserve actual proportions, toe volume, heel height, seams and texture; do not slim, elongate or redesign. CRITICAL: the outer side has a LARGE gold red-outlined TWO-ENDED curved arrow graphic wrapping over the toe with a hooked arrowhead near the laces AND a long narrow tail ending in an arrowhead toward heel. The inner side has a SEPARATE SMALL gold red-outlined hook near rear. These are custom Xstars graphics, NOT a generic Nike swoosh: faithfully copy from supplied real photos, no substitution, no extra hooks, no mirrored lettering or swapping sides. Tongue text XSTARS, outer text FLYWEAVE ULTRA where visible. Select angle that renders the actual graphics faithfully. No people, hands, props, pedestal, floating objects, packaging or watermarks. Keep product comfortably framed with margins unless a detail crop requested.  Shot direction: Two shoes in a confident staggered pair, front three-quarter camera slightly above upper, front shoe outer large wraparound arrow visible, back shoe offset and unobtrusive. Elegant diagonal placement across frame, natural actual shoe shape. Real left and right pair, not duplicated same foot.
